title: Banking Campaign and Customer Behavior
problem_statement: A retail bank needs to improve deposit-campaign efficiency by understanding conversion, contact burden, and segment differences without over-targeting vulnerable customers.
questions: Do channel differences persist within segments?
hypotheses: Digital contacts have lower cost per subscription.
Repeated contact has diminishing association with conversion.
recommendations: Set contact-frequency guardrails and track opt-outs.
Randomize eligible customers across channels before claiming channel effects.
